mechanism_narrative: MET (RTK) + IL6ST (gp130, cytokine receptor) forced proximity via rigid_helix_40 (~60Å) creates a biased signaling platform where MET's kinase trans-phosphorylates JAKs docked on IL6ST and IL6ST's JAKs phosphorylate MET's ICD, amplifying STAT3 activation. The transphosphorylation adaptor set (GRB2, SHC1, GAB1, PIK3R1, PTPN11, STAT3, JAK1, JAK2, FRS2) drives synergistic MAPK + PI3K/AKT + STAT3 signaling, while PLCG1/PLCG2 are sterically excluded by the 311aa ECD asymmetry and rigid linker geometry. This triple-axis output promotes muscle structural gene expression (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, MYOM2, TAGLN, MYL6, TPM2), satellite cell self-renewal (NOTCH3), and mitochondrial biogenesis (PPARGC1A), while suppressing aged IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN), stress/senescence markers (TXNIP, IL32, CDKN2A, IL6), and aged myogenic commitment (MYF5) — consistent with the past wins pattern.
